answer: Identity-bond decay: every identity holds one marble, a small bond token that cannot be split. Each epoch the bond loses a 5% delta of its value, so an identity that wanders off and stays silent shrinks until it must top up or vanish. Running 1,000 fakes means 1,000 marbles plus 5 POA each per epoch, 5,000 POA every epoch forever, while one honest identity pays 5 POA per epoch and keeps its full share. Decay never stops.
